completeness.why: Every provider keeps only its own bank lookup and passes account id, insert fields, sync source, tables and (Pluggy only) the file id to linkBankSyncAccount, which takes the whole upgrade/insert, payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and sync-event sequence; the unreachable id==null check is dropped.

interface.why: Parameters cover the real variations (accountData, accountSyncSource, tables, fileId), but includeFileId is a redundant flag next to the optional fileId (syncAccount's fileId is already optional) and forces a duplicated syncAccount call in a ternary; the institution-name comment is also copied onto every site.

disguised_duplication.where: The five copies are removed; the only repetition left is the two near-identical syncAccount calls in the includeFileId ternary inside linkBankSyncAccount, which is plain rather than disguised.
